verdict.rationale: Runway documents text-only video generation through Gen-4.5 and `POST /v1/text_to_video`. It also documents one way to build on a prior result: a cheap `draft: true` preview can be enhanced to 1080p by referencing its `draftTaskId`, and video-to-video plus Aleph editing can rework existing clips. Iteration is only partly evidenced: nothing shows prompt-level refinement or variations that keep a generated clip's content, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: documented prompt-refinement or variation workflow that preserves a prior generation, explicit evidence that generated clips can be fed back for editing, independent or hands-on corroboration of the text-to-video iteration loop.

support.subject: As a creator, I can turn a text prompt into a video clip and iterate on the result without starting from scratch each time

citations.quote: Gen-4.5 also generates video from text alone, without an input image. Send text-only requests to `POST /v1/text_to_video`
AI video generator: Generate video from text, an image or a clip.
A preview (`draft: true` on text to video, image to video, or video to video) bills at the 480p rate. Enhancing that preview to 1080p (`draftTaskId` on text to video)
